purpose: Teach: おそれ/おん/驚かさ/でん/折角/思い入れ/おもしろく/ひょっとしたら

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 高齢者の事故、増えるおそれ、あるな、最近のニュース。
lines.en: You know, these days you hear about elder accidents increasing. Just saw something about it in the news.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Patient pause after 'accidents.' Voice settles into the observation like he's been turning it over in his mind. Gentle, not alarmist. The cadence of someone used to sitting with difficult thoughts.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。あなたと私、おんなじ、考え方ね、いつも。
lines.en: Mmm. You and I, we think the same way about these things. Always have.
lines.style: Soft agreement, almost a hum on the opening. Voice warm with recognition. Not needing elaboration — this is the comfort of long knowing. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昨日の孫の言葉、お祖父ちゃん、驚かされたな、本当に。
lines.en: What our grandchild said yesterday really caught me off guard. Honestly.
lines.style: Slight surprise lifting the voice on 'grandchild.' Then settling into quiet amazement. A pause before 'honestly' — remembering that moment of being struck by clarity from someone so young.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの作るおでん、家族、皆、好きよ、温まるわね。
lines.en: The oden I make — the whole family loves it. It warms you right up, doesn't it.
lines.style: Gentle pride in the voice, but unshowy. Speaking from the warmth of making something others gather around. Soft, nurturing tone. Almost conversational, like she's remembering the steam rising.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 折角、息子が来てくれるんだから、御馳走、用意しような。
lines.en: Since our son is coming to visit, we should prepare something really nice for him.
lines.style: Purposeful energy — not urgent, but a quiet determination to do this well. Voice brightens slightly with anticipation. The care in it is straightforward, not sentimental. A little eager underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔の結婚写真、私、思い入れがあるのよ、見るたびに。
lines.en: That old wedding photo of ours — I have so many feelings about it. Every time I look at it.
lines.style: Voice softens on 'wedding.' A long breath underneath, carrying decades. Tender but not fragile. The trailing phrase lingers gently — she's far away for a moment, holding something precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近のテレビ、おもしろく感じるものが、少ないな、お母さん。
lines.en: There's not much on television these days that I find interesting, you know.
lines.style: Dry, gentle observation. A small laugh in the voice — not bitter, just the wry knowing of someone who's seen enough to be selective. Settling back into his chair with the comment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ひょっとしたら、来年、孫、結婚するかもしれないわね、楽しみ。
lines.en: You know, next year our grandchild might get married. Wouldn't that be something.
lines.style: Voice lights with quiet possibility. Wondering aloud, not quite certain but hopeful. Warm speculation — the joy is gentle, almost private. Trails off with soft contentment.
